requirements.text: Synchronous active-high reset: grant becomes 0 and requester 0 has the highest priority at the next edge.
grant is registered: it reflects req sampled at the previous rising edge; a lone requester is granted at every edge it asks.
grant is one-hot or all zero: never more than one requester granted at a time.
No grant without a request: grant[i] is 1 only if req[i] was 1 at that edge; with no request grant is 0 and the priority is unchanged.
Round robin: the winner is the first requester at or after the priority pointer, in the order 0, 1, 2, 3, 0, ...; after a grant to i the pointer moves to i+1 (mod 4).
Fairness: a requester that holds req high is granted within 4 cycles, whatever the other requesters do.
